idea-plugin.name: hgrider
idea-plugin.description:
hgrider brings practical Mercurial (hg) tools to JetBrains IDEs.

The point is reviewing your own branch inside the IDE, file by file, the way Upsource does it.

  • Hg Changes: an Upsource-style tree of branch changes with per-file +N -M, comparison modes (uncommitted, entire branch vs parent, vs parent branch HEAD, vs custom branch), filter/exclude and revert.
  • Review marks: an eye column marks a file as reviewed — per directory as well — with a progress counter; marks are stored per project and survive restarts.
  • Hg File History: hg log -f for the file in the editor or selected in Hg Changes. A revision is diffed against its first parent, renames are followed, and a revision that creates or deletes the file renders an empty side.
  • TODO mode: TODO comments in changed files, including unsaved editor buffers.
  • Hg Export: copy open editor files to a folder or open it in Total Commander.

Output of hg is decoded line by line as UTF-8 with a configurable fallback encoding, so commit messages written in a legacy codepage stay readable.

Requires the Mercurial command-line client available as hg on PATH.
